about_the_game:
✨ HattenX: Gamify Your Japanese Learning

HattenX is designed for learners who want to test and improve their Japanese reading vocabulary in a more engaging way. If you're tired of traditional flashcards and passive study methods, HattenX offers a new approach: learning through interactive gameplay.

You and your friends can play together in a Japanese boss mini-game where correct answers deal damage to the boss. The system reinforces your vocabulary through active recall, and mistakes are treated as learning opportunities to help you improve over time.
(So don’t be afraid to get things wrong. you’ll learn the word eventually!)

HattenX aims to make studying more motivating, especially for those who enjoy games and want to integrate language learning into something fun, rewarding, and social.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or compatible
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Vulkan support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
